mechanism: Negative volume index (NVI) accumulates price changes only on volume contraction days, tracking smart money accumulation in stainless steel during quiet periods. When institutional participants reduce activity while maintaining directional exposure, NVI rises indicating informed positioning. SS shows strong momentum performance (16/26 gate_pass) but limited inventory testing (2/5), suggesting positioning signals may add orthogonal information to price-based momentum.
symbol_fit: SS (stainless steel) has concentrated industrial end-users and nickel cost-pass-through dynamics, creating periods where commercial hedgers dominate flow during low-volume consolidation. NVI captures this smart money behavior distinct from retail-driven high-volume noise trading.
predicted_direction: NVI_increasing_on_volume_contraction -> smart_money_accumulation -> price_up; NVI_decreasing_on_volume_contraction -> smart_money_distribution -> price_down
kill_condition: aligned dir_acc below ss adaptive effective_min (0.520) OR NVI shows correlation >0.85 with raw price momentum (no orthogonal information)
promote_condition: aligned gate_pass AND fdr_pass with inventory-family dir_acc >= 0.520, demonstrating positioning adds value beyond momentum on stainless steel
